<!-- pr-reviewer: 02c79889d3894e72ca442bfe41c188d588a18544 -->
**Needs changes before merge** - one process item (missing `PROCESS_VERSION` bump); the change itself is sound.

**What looks good**
- The fix does what #1068 asks. With the same one-line probe in `crates/motion/src/{machining2d,machining3d,multiaxis}/mod.rs`, `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main --dry-run` before this PR's header selected app suites `area_open, edge_break_gate, lathe_spindle_fit, lathe_spindle_keyed, trochoid_op`. After, it selects those plus `operations`. Nothing was dropped; motion suites are unchanged.
- The new xtask test pins both halves (map names all six generators; a `multiaxis` change plans `camcraft-app` + `operations`) against the checkout, so a header that loses a name fails in xtask's own suite.
- The test uses `expect`/`panic!` only inside `#[test]`; no product code changed.

**Local results (PR merged with upstream/main at the time of review, clean merge, no conflicts)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 33 passed, 0 failed (the PR body says 34; main's count differs, new test included and passing) |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| app operations suite | not re-run: the diff to `operations.rs` is a `//!` comment line only |

**Requested before merge**
1. `xtask/src/tests.rs` is under `xtask/`, a process file. AGENTS.md ("Process changes bump `PROCESS_VERSION`") requires the PR to also increment `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` (main is 16 -> 17). Note #965 (17), #967 (18), #972 (19) and #1033 (20) already claim numbers; whichever merges later renumbers on its merge of main.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- Merge order / stacking: #965, #967, #972 and #1033 each also edit the `Gate map (M4.4)` line of `crates/app/tests/operations.rs` (verified in their file lists), so this PR conflicts with each as soon as one of them lands (and vice versa). It is not stacked on them. Suggest landing it after #965 and re-merging main: the header must then keep #965's crate-qualified names plus `motion::machining3d`, `motion::multiaxis` and `motion::plunge_law` (as the PR body says). The new xtask test would catch a lost name.
- The PR body says "Fixes #1068" and has a `Changelog:` line; since it only changes a test-map header and an xtask test, a `none` changelog may fit better.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

<!-- pr-reviewer: cf99332dc83b8cafc1f267c74dd65af86c253fa7 -->
**Ready for the maintainer to merge.**

Re-review of the new head (cf99332d, merge of main on top of 6af3a4ca).

**What looks good**
- `.claude/PROCESS_VERSION` is 42; `origin/main` (7abab8f7) is 41 at review time, so the bump is main+1, and the body says 41 -> 42. The earlier blocker is cleared.
- `operations.rs` change is a gate-map comment only (adds `motion::machining3d`, `motion::multiaxis`, `motion::plunge_law`), so no app build was needed.
- New xtask test `motion_generator_change_selects_the_operations_suite` pins both the map names and that a `crates/motion/src/multiaxis/mod.rs` change selects `app:operations`.
- Diff is 3 files only; no deps, build.rs, scripts or .github touched. Branch contains current main and merges cleanly.

**Local results (merged with main)**
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p xtask` | 90 passed, 1 failed (see below) |
| `motion_generator_change_selects_the_operations_suite` | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p xtask --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |

The one failure is `gate_maps_tests::no_gate_map_names_a_moved_module_as_app`:
```
Gate maps naming moved modules as app::<module>: ["grblhal_post: app::post", "tinyg_post: app::post"]
```
I ran that same test on a plain detached checkout of `origin/main` (7abab8f7) and it fails identically. It is red on main independent of this PR; those two suite headers are not in this PR's diff. Not a blocker here; it is a main defect to be fixed separately.

**Requested before merge**: none.

**Notes (not blocking)**
- After merge, the pinned issue #681 needs the `PROCESS_VERSION 42` comment.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
